_comment: Link check runs against a locally served copy of ./out (see the link-check job in .github/workflows/ci.yml and the preview:linkcheck script) so extensionless routes like /resources resolve the same way GitHub Pages serves them, instead of 404ing against resources.html on the raw filesystem. External links are intentionally skipped: third-party sites going down or rate-limiting CI would make the check flaky, and validating our own pages and in-page anchors is what catches real regressions. The skip pattern matches every URL except the real local origin — :3200 must be followed by an origin boundary (/, ?, #, or end of string) so a userinfo trick like http://localhost:3200@evil.com is treated as external and skipped, not crawled.
